terms.comment: Morgan–Owens’s phrase for the train. Traupman has the railway, ferrivia subterrānea (see metro).

phrases.latin: Sub terrā currit trāmen, sub viīs, sub domibus
phrases.english: The train runs under the ground, under the streets, under the houses

sources: Theodōrus et pater · Ad Larem avītum, Libellī I–VII, as they stood on 7 November 2026, with their glosses. Examples marked “Libellus” quote those texts word for word; classical passages are cited by author.
Morgan–Owens, Adumbratio: s.v. subway (U.S.), underground (Br.), metro.
